_doc: - keystone/primary/secondary names must match lcu_rune_writer constants.
- item display names are fuzzy-resolved against ddragon (apostrophes, spaces, case stripped).
- summoner IDs: 1 cleanse, 3 exhaust, 4 flash, 6 ghost, 7 heal, 11 smite, 12 teleport, 14 ignite, 21 barrier, 32 mark/snowball.
Builds are hand-curated to match the champion's actual meta playstyle —
ARAM variants intentionally include funky off-meta options (on-hit Lulu,
tank Veigar, AP Sona) where they're genuinely viable in the random-pick
context. Add more by hand-editing — resolver re-checks mtime per call.
